# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| triage-record | One line per request, as in "Output of a triage" | `catalog-usecase`, `funnel-use-case`, `funnel-requirements`, `funnel-first-aid`, The lane's entry skill:  (Lane 1) | Channel, exactly one lane, owner role, trigger satisfied, definition of done, priority basis (`UNKNOWN` is allowed), expected gate, known blockers |
| expected-gate | Field in the triage record | `dept-decision-rights` | The gate is named at intake with its owner |
| refusal | Reply to the demand owner | Demand owner | Gives the reason and the route (owning function); A refusal is returned, not dropped |
| system-fit-flag | Note in the triage record | `invest-screen` | Raised whenever the ask implies a system outside the lean footprint |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| triage-record | manual | The lane's entry skill:  (Lane 1) |
| expected-gate | manual | OD lead |
| refusal | manual | Demand owner |
| system-fit-flag | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `comms-followup`, `dept-context`
- **Next:** step i1 to invest-screen where needed, then catalog-usecase (Lane 1), funnel-use-case (Lane 2, step 21), funnel-requirements (Lane 3, step 31) or funnel-first-aid.: `invest-screen`, `catalog-usecase`, `funnel-use-case`, `funnel-requirements`, `funnel-first-aid`
- **Stops here when:** the request belongs to another function, has no plant-roadmap link or nameable business case, fails the SMART test, or needs a system outside the lean footprint
- **Stops here when:** Return it to the demand owner with the reason and the route
- **Stops here when:** Never record a priority that was inferred
